mapper.select: /* AppChkLst01Mapper.selectChkLstInfo */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.CHKLST_TYPE AS chklstType , A.CHKPT_DESC AS chkptDesc , A.CHKPT_NM AS chkptNm , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , B.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AS inspectItemCd , B.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ AS inspectItemSubj , 'Y' AS inspectValue , B.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT A INNER JOIN TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.CHKLST_TYPE = B.CHKLST_TYPE ) LEFT JOIN TB_SITE S ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = S.SITE_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{ token.gv_cmpnyCd } AND A.SITE_CD = #{ param.siteCd } AND A.CHKPT_CD = #{ param.chkptCd } AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.STR_DATE <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY B.SORT_IDX
